We're picking an on-call scheduling tool for our engineering team of 40 people, and we need single sign-on. Please read the pricing pages for Clockwren, Wakespan and Vigilark:

https://clockwren.example/pricing
https://wakespan.example/pricing
https://vigilark.example/pricing

Write notes/pricing.md with each vendor's plans, the price per seat per month on yearly billing (and on monthly billing where they show it), any seat minimums, and which plan includes single sign-on and what it costs. Then work out what 40 seats with single sign-on would cost for a year on yearly billing at each vendor, and recommend the cheapest. Stick to what the pages say.

# On-call scheduling pricing comparison

Prices below are per paid seat, in USD. Annual billing figures are monthly rates billed yearly; totals assume 40 paid seats for a full year and no taxes or other add-ons unless required for SSO.

## Clockwren

| Plan | Yearly billing (per seat/month) | Monthly billing (per seat/month) | Seat minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| Free | $0 (up to 5 users) | Not shown | Up to 5 users | Not listed |
| Team | $19 | $23 | Not stated | Not listed |
| Business | $36 | $43 | 10 users | Included (SAML); SCIM provisioning also included |
| Enterprise | Talk to sales | Not shown | Not stated | Includes everything in Business; price not stated |

**40 seats with SSO, yearly billing:** Business is the priced plan with SAML SSO: 40 × $36 × 12 = **$17,280/year**. Enterprise also includes Business features, but its price is not provided, so its total cannot be calculated from the page.

## Wakespan

| Plan | Yearly billing (per seat/month) | Monthly billing (per seat/month) | Seat minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| Starter | $16 | $20 | Not stated | Not listed |
| Professional | $29 | $35 | Not stated | Not listed |
| Enterprise | $47 | Not offered (annual only) | 25 users | Included (SAML and OIDC) |

**40 seats with SSO, yearly billing:** Enterprise: 40 × $47 × 12 = **$22,560/year**. The 25-user minimum is met.

## Vigilark

| Plan | Yearly billing (per seat/month) | Monthly billing (per seat/month) | Seat minimum | Single sign-on |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| Basic | $11 | $14 | Any number | Not listed |
| Pro | $24 | $30 | 8 seats | SAML add-on: $4 per seat/month, billed on the same basis as the plan |

**40 seats with SSO, yearly billing:** Pro plus SSO add-on is $24 + $4 = $28 per seat/month. 40 × $28 × 12 = **$13,440/year**. The 8-seat minimum is met.

## Recommendation

For 40 seats with single sign-on on yearly billing, **Vigilark is the cheapest priced option at $13,440/year**. Clockwren Business is $17,280/year, and Wakespan Enterprise is $22,560/year. Clockwren Enterprise includes Business features (and therefore SSO), but the page says to contact sales and gives no price, so it cannot be included in the price ranking.
